title: tag_run tool has no test coverage
description: tag_run.rs was created without a companion tag_run_tests.rs file. Other tools (create_candidate_tag, git_commit, create_branch) have test files. Expected impact: adding tests would reduce end_review_error_count in future runs that modify tag_run.rs.
proposed_resolution: Create src/moeb/src/tools/tag_run_tests.rs with tests for missing-field validation and git-invocation error handling.
